name: Social Export
description: Share photos sized and shaped for each social network. Post straight to Bluesky, Mastodon and Pixelfed with alt text, or save files ready for Instagram, Facebook, X and Threads and open the site. Copy one to paste anywhere.
author: Anthony Reimche

permissions.reason: Signs in to the Bluesky, Mastodon or Pixelfed account you choose and posts the photos you share there. A Mastodon or Pixelfed server, or a Bluesky server you run yourself, is asked about before Safelight reaches it.
